ticket.title: Total Hours is displayed inconsistently in Month View

scope: Fix: in Month View the Scheduled/Total/Absence hours toolbar stats aggregate over the whole displayed month, not the active ISO week. Read-only run on My attendance as the default account; June 2026 from the repro plus current month.

cases.title: Month view June 2026 stats are month-wide and not the week-view values
cases.preconditions: Account has attendance data in June 2026

steps.action: Open Attendance > My attendance, switch View to Month view, navigate to June 2026
steps.expected: Toolbar shows month-wide Scheduled/Total/Absence hours for June 2026
steps.actual: June 2026 Month view toolbar: 'Scheduled hours: 160 / Total hours: 0 / Absence hours: 160' (month-wide; Oct 2026 month showed 176/0/48, week 5-11 Oct showed 40/0/32, so not the week value). Account has no actual hours in June so the 0-vs-55 value cannot be reproduced.

cases.title: Month stats stay stable after switching Week/Month and navigating away and back

steps.action: Switch to Week view and back to Month view (June 2026)
steps.expected: Total hours equal the TC01 value
steps.actual: After Month->Week->Month on June 2026: Scheduled 160, Total 0, Absence 160, identical.

steps.action: Go to Next month then Previous month
steps.expected: June 2026 Total hours equal the TC01 value
steps.actual: After Next month then Previous month: June 2026 still Scheduled 160, Total 0, Absence 160.

observations: The default account has no actual hours in June 2026 (Total 0), so the ticket 55-vs-0 data cannot be reproduced; stability and month-wide aggregation were checked but a non-zero total was not.
